name: Benjamin Netanyahu
role: Prime Minister of Israel (Rosh HaMemshala, ראש הממשלה)
bio: Benjamin Netanyahu, born in Tel Aviv in 1949, a former officer in the Sayeret Matkal special-forces unit and a graduate of the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, has been Prime Minister of Israel since 29 December 2022, an office he previously held in 1996–1999 and 2009–2021, which makes him the country's longest-serving head of government. After serving as ambassador to the United Nations (1984–1988), he entered the Knesset for Likud in 1988, led the party from 1993 to 1999 and again since 2005, won the first direct election for prime minister in 1996, and served under Ariel Sharon as foreign minister (2002–2003) and finance minister (2003–2005). Since May 2020 he has been on trial in the Jerusalem District Court on charges of bribery, fraud and breach of trust in Cases 1000, 2000 and 4000, which he denies, the first sitting Israeli prime minister to stand trial; his November 2025 request for a presidential pardon was still undecided as of October 2026, and an arrest warrant issued by the International Criminal Court in November 2024, which Israel contests, remains in force. His sixth government, formed with ultra-Orthodox and far-right parties, launched a judicial overhaul that prompted mass protests in 2023 and was in office during the Hamas-led attack of 7 October 2023, in which about 1,200 people were killed and 251 taken hostage according to Israeli figures, and the war in Gaza that followed, in which more than 74,000 Palestinians had been killed by October 2026 according to the Gaza Health Ministry, whose figures do not distinguish civilians from combatants; a US-brokered ceasefire took effect in October 2025 and all hostages had been returned by January 2026. Israel under his government also fought Hezbollah in Lebanon (2023–2024 and 2026) and Iran (June 2025, and from 28 February 2026 jointly with the United States). As of 22 October 2026 he heads the outgoing government and Likud's list for the Knesset election of 27 October 2026, the first held on its legal date since 1988.
